sprint_report.goals: This sprint aimed to enhance the Intake asset management system by completing the BackupNav data integration pipeline and improving the foundational data structure through table design work. In parallel, the team strengthened incident management capabilities in Fulfillment and established critical notification infrastructure for M2S customers.
sprint_report.summary: The team successfully completed the full BackupNav data integration workflow, including review protocols, import functionality, and the finalized spreadsheet template that will enable seamless asset data ingestion into the system. Supporting this integration, the Intake team designed and implemented the Site Code and Location tables while updating incident workflows to automatically pull configuration item information, establishing a more robust asset-to-incident relationship. On the Fulfillment side, the team improved incident creation visibility by adding submitter notifications, enforced data quality by making the Assignment Group field mandatory, and streamlined the default incident list view to surface the most relevant information to operators. Additionally, the team configured notification routing for FieldGear ORBIT customers in M2S and synchronized code across development and test environments, ensuring consistency and readiness for downstream deployment.
